task.title: P6-135: Stop ownership-read failures from turning catalog search into a 500 for signed-in users
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Catalog, search and paging). Original id: P6-135. Size: S. Specs: specs/collection-api.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**A failure in the ownership read turns catalog search into a 500 for signed-in users only** (was `P6-038a`). `search` now opens an RLS transaction it previously never needed (`hosted.rs:314`); anonymous callers keep working. There is no fallback degrading `owned` to `None` while still serving results, and adding one is small.
